topic.title: MQTT Topic Filter
topic.description: Topic to subscribe to; supports +/# wildcards and {asset}/{stream} placeholders. Omit for a writeback-only stream (control_topic only).

payload_field.title: Payload Field
payload_field.description: Optional: dotted path to a value inside a JSON payload (e.g. readings.pressure). Omit to use the whole payload.

control_topic.title: Control Topic
control_topic.description: Optional: control changes for this stream are published to this topic; supports {asset}/{stream} placeholders.
